evidence.text: - **Changing contents:** A single-land Power normally counts contents when used and fixes the effect then. Island-wide effects defined for a class of lands check current contents when relevant (for example, **Dahan on their Guard** counts Dahan when Damage occurs). **Encompassing Ward** follows the target Spirit's current Presence, rather than marking the lands occupied when it was used. An explicitly moving effect is an exception. [Core: do-island-wide-effects-check-land-contents-at-resolution, .7w4ganu]
